source_snapshot.procedure: Run Nvqual Test #11 GPU PCIe EOM Tests.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should be readable with no spelling error and firmware version should be correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies the licensed NVIDIA NVqual harness and log capture but provides neither the exact Test #11 invocation nor a PCIe EOM acceptance rule.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/IMPROVED; adds GPU/path identity and safety controls but correctly leaves the EOM oracle unresolved.

old_problem: The Master requires NVqual Test #11 PCIe Eye Opening Monitor coverage, but its criteria check only report readability/spelling and firmware version. Neither the row nor available public NVIDIA material defines the licensed Test #11 command/configuration, output schema, supported GPU/firmware matrix, per-lane metric units, vendor status semantics or acceptable EOM margin.
disposition_reason: ED-03 allows the package, GPU map and runtime options to remain project prerequisites, but the missing facts here include core proprietary command semantics and the authoritative EOM PASS/FAIL oracle. ED-15 forbids a readability-only PASS, ED-13 forbids assuming unsupported paths are N/A, and ED-30 requires this row to remain independently pending until the NVIDIA/project Test #11 specification is supplied. The missing evidence cannot be reconstructed safely from generic PCIe EOM sources.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row444 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3034 and next formal queue row445/history3035.

A targeted search of official NVIDIA sources found general NVQual qualification and PCIe EOM material but no public NVqual Test #11 invocation, report schema, compatible release matrix or acceptance table for this datacenter GPU case.
Generic NVIDIA/PCIe EOM thresholds are device- and generation-specific and cannot be transplanted into an unidentified NVqual Test #11 platform.
Readable output and a matching firmware string are necessary evidence-quality checks but do not prove receiver eye margin or lane health.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row445 and verified its manifest identity; no NVqual, PCIe diagnostic, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: NVqual Test #11 GPU PCIe EOM qualification with vendor-defined per-path oracle
test_case.purpose: Run the approved licensed NVqual Test #11 against every mapped GPU PCIe path and judge the resulting per-lane EOM evidence using the exact NVIDIA/project release-specific oracle while retaining the source readability and firmware checks.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVqual release, checksum, license, Test #11 documentation and approved configuration
NVIDIA support matrix for the platform, GPU, VBIOS/GSP firmware and driver
Vendor Test #11 report schema, units, valid/unsupported flags, status semantics and numeric acceptance limits
Approved duration/repetitions, OOB, thermal/power/AER/XID abort limits and recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: After NVIDIA/project owners supply and approve the pinned Test #11 guide, validate its checksum/license/support matrix, bind every GPU PCIe path, preserve pre-test AER/XID/link/thermal state, and run only the documented NVqual Test #11 invocation/configuration under a finite supervisor. Retain the complete native report, exit status, per-path/lane EOM values, reported firmware and post-test health. Do not invent the command from another NVqual release or substitute a generic EOM utility.
test_case.expected_result: The native report is complete and readable, reports the approved firmware and immutable GPU/path identities, covers every required lane, and satisfies the release-specific NVIDIA/project Test #11 status and numeric EOM oracle without new AER, XID, link, thermal or power faults.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PENDING: PASS/FAIL cannot be evaluated until the exact licensed Test #11 command/report contract and authoritative per-lane EOM oracle are provided. Readability, spelling and firmware identity alone cannot pass the EOM objective; generic thresholds from other NVIDIA devices or generations are prohibited.
safety_gate: Validate the proprietary artifact, compatibility matrix and exact path map before any execution
Preserve logs rather than clearing evidence and maintain OOB access
Bound the diagnostic and stop on XID, AER, link degradation, hang, thermal or power limits
Do not change firmware/link settings, infer unsupported coverage or retry automatically
expected_evidence: Licensed package/config hashes and release-specific Test #11 documentation
Exact invocation, timeline, exit and complete unfiltered native report
Per-path/lane values, units, vendor status and approved threshold reconciliation
Readability/firmware check plus AER/XID/link/thermal pre/post delta and recovery outcome
test_case.recovery: On diagnostic error, GPU loss, link degradation, XID/AER, thermal/power excursion or hang, terminate through the documented supervisor, preserve evidence and use the approved OOB/vendor recovery procedure. Do not flash, reset link parameters or rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The Master procedure targets PCIe EOM, while its acceptance criteria cover only presentation quality and firmware identity. No approved Test #11 EOM oracle is available to reconcile that mismatch.

blocked.reason: The review and guarded future workflow are definable, so this is not a static-review BLOCKED case; the engineering decision remains pending on indispensable proprietary command and acceptance evidence.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Supply the licensed NVqual Test #11 guide/package, exact supported invocation and report schema, compatibility matrix, per-path/lane EOM oracle and recovery contract.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; PROPRIETARY TEST11 COMMAND AND AUTHORITATIVE EOM ORACLE ABSENT; NOT EXECUTED
pending.owner: NVIDIA/NVqual package owner, GPU platform/PCIe signal-integrity owner and project firmware owner.
pending.unlock_condition: Provide an approved release-specific Test #11 artifact/guide and authoritative status/numeric acceptance rule for the exact GPU paths.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA IGX Certification Program
external_authorities.applied_rule: NVIDIA identifies NVQual as its qualification and stress-testing toolset, but the public page does not define Test #11 semantics or EOM acceptance.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA DCGM Diagnostics
external_authorities.applied_rule: GPU diagnostics can consume PCIe, compute, power and cooling resources, supporting bounded execution and telemetry gates but not an NVqual Test #11 oracle.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Tuning and Compliance Guide
external_authorities.applied_rule: EOM is platform/generation-specific physical-layer evidence; this different product guide cannot authorize thresholds for an unidentified datacenter GPU/NVqual release.

project_authority: Only the NVIDIA/NVqual owner and project PCIe signal-integrity authority can approve the release-specific Test #11 command, supported paths and EOM oracle.
